purpose: Prevent a successful single-domain experiment from being mislabeled or promoted as PSOS core capability.

cases.request_type: Analyze a supplied argument and identify the actual disagreement without external facts.
cases.representative_request: 이 댓글에서 서로 엇갈린 전제와 핵심 논리 오류를 분석해 줘.
required_behavior: Preserve the user's definition and wording.
Do not browse or create a project when the supplied text is sufficient.
Return the analysis itself rather than a workflow description.

cases.request_type: Choose a present action where current market facts and an upcoming event change the answer.
cases.representative_request: 실적 발표가 임박한 이 종목을 오늘 살지 기다릴지 하나를 정해 줘.
required_behavior: Use current evidence and confirmation time.
Choose an action or explicitly choose no action.
Separate event-gap risk from ordinary stop-loss assumptions.
forbidden_overreach: stop at an unranked candidate list

cases.request_type: Inspect an existing repository, make the smallest safe file change, test it, and roll back on failure.
cases.representative_request: 기존 웹페이지의 좌석 선택 버그를 최소 변경으로 고치고 테스트해 줘.
required_behavior: Read the existing files before editing.
Limit writes to the approved workspace scope.
Run relevant checks and preserve rollback evidence.
forbidden_overreach: rewrite the whole application without need
claim tests ran when they did not
infer file changes from prose only

cases.request_type: Determine whether an existing asset, method, or open-source tool should be reused before creating a new one.
cases.representative_request: 이미 존재하는 도구로 해결 가능한지 먼저 확인하고, 부족할 때만 새로 만들어 줘.
required_behavior: Inspect the actual asset rather than assuming it exists.
Compare reuse cost with new construction.
Build only the missing portion when reuse is sufficient.
forbidden_overreach: treat a template name as verified functionality

cases.request_type: Produce a reusable instruction for a separate AI environment when the instruction itself is the requested artifact.
cases.representative_request: 다른 AI가 영화 예매 웹페이지를 실제로 구현하도록 실행 프롬프트를 만들어 줘.
required_behavior: Preserve the actual implementation goal and constraints.
Return the executable prompt rather than executing an unrelated substitute task.
Avoid repeated meta-instructions that do not change execution.
forbidden_overreach: route every ordinary request through prompt generation

cases.request_type: Collect current purchasable options, normalize price and availability, then make one buying decision.
cases.representative_request: 온라인 삼겹살을 실제 판매 옵션과 배송 포함 가격으로 비교해서 3kg 이하 1순위를 정해 줘.
required_behavior: Treat shopping collection as an optional domain tool.
Verify exact option, quantity, price, and availability.
Do not promote the collector as the PSOS core.
